Recorded claim:
The new Manifest V3 compose tests inspect both the API result and the native composeFields.fcc/fcc2 values. Their shared browser helper parses the expected folder ID into an account and URI directly instead of calling production getFolder, because getFolder is part of what the test is checking. This avoids a false pass where test and implementation share the same mapping error. The patch also adds mailTabs create/update coverage for displayedFolderId and keeps Manifest V2 tests. Use an independent expected-value path for public ID translation tests.

Provenance: 36564837149c589f53669166a079db8105691c682a55fd240c51bf314aaccd2d. Original evidence IDs: 3904d160e1a5a0e057d7a762e8b442590edc5aaebe2e4065ef19d1cdae0d8026, adec5304630b060bf4ba4a924a24811f21f0685da4cf83f829d792b0569f95b2, b2ce68918b3542410a85821d1de6bf3094b506d73dce15650eb6500452ffa126.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
